              授業の概要および学習上の助言

                 In this course, students will learn many effective methods to pass the entrance examinations by companies. First, some techniques of industry and company analysis, self-analysis, and construction of carrier design will be reviewed. Next, participation to company information session, written examination, and intervirew examination will be learned.
